cross_cutting_disagreements: WHERE THE TRANSCRIPT LIVES. Harness and systems put the conversation transcript on the Ledger as a typed session:<id> stream (checkpoint = every turn, resume = fold); cognitive keeps working memory OUT of the Ledger as the in-memory WorkingMemory class keyed by (person, channel). The Ledger stream is right: resume after restart, evals from real transcripts, compaction with something to compact, audit, and the Verification trajectory check all read the same data, and it is what blueprint 4.4 and the creator's persistent-daemon intent (02 section 6.1) ask for. Cognitive's 'feed WorkingMemory from turn.completed' is fine as a zero-contract stage-1 stopgap only; the ledger-cost objection is answered by per-turn (not per-block) appends and by moving telemetry out of the event log (systems).

THINK OVER THE BUS VS AN INJECTED LLM GATEWAY. Harness moves the model call to an in-process Llm protocol injected by the Kernel (bus kept for effects, events, surfaces); cognitive, systems and embodied keep cognition.think as a bus request (adding deadline/stream/partial fields). Harness is right on the mechanism for single mode: a streaming, large-payload, synchronous call inside one process is what produced one trace stream per message (88k files) and the 300 s handler timeout as every task's wall budget, and streaming deltas cannot sensibly be bus RPC replies. But it must be done as a contracts.protocols.Llm protocol with a bus-backed adapter for local-multi/aws so principle 4.2 and the boundary test survive, and cognition.think must remain on the bus for Planning, Memory consolidation and Verification (harness itself says so). session.delta as bus-only (never ledgered) is the correct surface feed.

WHEN NATIVE TOOL USE LANDS. Systems stage 1 and harness stage 2 put it first; embodied stage 3 pilots it on VOICE_CHAT only; cognitive defers it to stage 6 as 'dependent on the tool lens'. Early is right: it is the verified root of the seven regex police in session.py, of multi-property MCP tools being uncallable (execution/mcp.py mcp_single_arg_key returns None), and it is a prerequisite for any critic that cannot be fooled by echoed results -- which cognitive concedes. Two conditions from harness must hold: markers stay as a per-provider fallback dialect, and the default flips per model only after BFCL and the trial suite beat markers on the model actually in use. Embodied's voice-profile-first pilot is a good bounded first flip. Note for all four: tool.registered does NOT carry args_schema today (schema_ref is ''), so 'schemas to the model' is a contract addition, not a rendering change.

WHAT STAGE 0 IS. Systems: telemetry cut-over. Harness: promote the trial suite + benchmark + fixture evals to the gate. Cognitive: wire what exists + build continuity and resume-after-kill eval sets. Embodied: HomeRule recompute + physical posture + requester on proposals. These are not exclusive and all but the telemetry cut-over are about a week; the right stage 0 is their union: embodied's physical-safety fix (a verified gap, one week, additive), cognitive's config flips and two wires, and the gate promotion with the two eval sets. Systems is right that later latency work is unmeasurable without spans, but the ledger-backend and trace-format change is bigger than a week and should be stage 1, run alongside native tool use, not ahead of the safety fix.

BUDGET UNIT. Harness and systems replace the per-attempt step cap with (turns, tokens, usd, wall-clock) budgets; cognitive keeps steps and adds checkpoints. Tokens/usd/wall win: 'step budget exhausted' is the leading benchmark failure, one step is an arbitrary unit once a turn can carry N tool_use blocks, and cost is what the creator actually pays for. Keep the step cap only as a sanity bound.

COMPACTION TRIGGER. Cognitive: switch on reground_every_steps=3 now (config only); harness: measured token pressure with tool-result aging first, then the progress note, for every session kind. Both are right in sequence: cognitive's is the correct first increment (verified built-and-off, measurable in a day), harness's is the correct end state (step count is not what fills a window). All three loop proposals agree the ProgressNote shape (goal/done/learned/next/open questions) is the right compaction artifact; keep it.

GROWTH LAYER OUTPUT TYPE AND PROMOTION SIGNAL. Cognitive: four typed policy artifacts (task-type rule, skill, routing change, code patch) in a versioned store with TTL/retire, adopted via Guardian; harness: skills, memory facts and config/prompt PRs through the harness, promoted on an eval delta; systems: skills only, with competence computed from eval pass rates rather than self-reported outcomes; embodied: routines installed into HA with a person's yes. Resolution: cognitive's artifact store is the most complete design and task-type rules as the first kind is right (cheapest loop closure), but systems is right that the promotion signal must be eval pass rates, not the outcome-fed posteriors alone, and harness is right that a rule is a prompt change and must be A/B'd on the trial suite before it is active. All four agree the loop must never touch Guardian, agent definitions, hooks or the gate; make that a Guardian-protected subject, not a convention. Embodied's routine loop is orthogonal and correct.

PACKAGE CONSOLIDATION. Harness merges orchestration + cognition's assembler/parser/compaction + profiles/scaffolds into agent/ and slims cognition to llm/; cognitive and systems keep every package and add files; embodied adds six packages and splits voice and interface. Resolution: harness's 'one ContextBuilder' is already decided in 07 section 3.2 ('one owner for context assembly') and should be done; the physical package move is not required for any behaviour win and is the riskiest diff for one developer, so land the ContextBuilder, native tools, session stream and compaction inside existing packages first (cognitive/systems shape) and do the moves last, gated by the trial suite. Embodied's channels/admin split is a later cleanup, not a priority.

GUARDIAN: TIERS VS A PHYSICAL AXIS. Systems proposes four safety tiers by reversibility x scope x origin x blast radius with tier 3 human always; embodied proposes a separate physical axis (HomeRule recomputing classify_call, PersonRule, PresenceRule, its own posture and auto-approve). They are complementary, not contradictory: systems' tier model is the general frame, embodied's HomeRule/requester field are the missing wires that put physical actions in tier 2/3 correctly. Embodied's is more urgent because the gap is verified in code today (Guardian trusts the proposer's reversibility label; one env knob covers doors and docstrings).

MEMORY RECALL BUDGET. Cognitive raises it to ~1 s and prefetches on percept; systems takes it from the envelope deadline; harness replaces the 0.25 s bus RPCs with in-process read protocols. Once the embedder is warm at boot and vectors are persisted (all three agree), recall answers in tens of ms and the timeout stops mattering; prefetch-on-percept (cognitive) is the cheapest change that removes it from the voice critical path today. Keep the explicit 'memory could not be consulted' note in every design.

EXPLORATION TARGET SPACE. Cognitive redirects curiosity to household entities and unanswered questions via Thompson sampling over posteriors; systems keeps the diversity sampler verbatim; harness turns it into the scheduler for idle improvement tasks. Resolution: keep the sampler mechanism (its diversity-by-construction is principle 4.13 and has a regression test) and change its inputs -- posteriors instead of the constant gap compute_gaps returns today, and a target space beyond repo areas. No real contradiction.

COMPOSITE VERDICT (why harness wins and what it must borrow). On this judge's mandate -- technical depth and alignment with where capable agents demonstrably are -- harness is the strongest single design: typed turns, native tools with a Guardian PreToolUse hook, parallel blocks, cacheable prefix, token-pressure compaction, agent definitions, sub-agents, one Stop hook replacing the police. It is not the safest plan to execute as written. The plan the creator should run is harness's loop and end state, sequenced as: embodied stage 0 (physical safety, one week) + cognitive stage 1 (wires and config flips, eval sets) + harness stage 0 (gate) first; systems' telemetry and evals package next, in parallel with native tool use behind a per-provider flag; then session stream, ContextBuilder and compaction inside existing packages; cognitive's fact store and posteriors; systems' safety tiers folded with embodied's HomeRule; the growth merge last, with harness's rule that it can never touch its own gate. The package moves of harness stage 4 are deferred until the trial suite and evals gate them.

result.lens: Synthesis. Spine: the harness proposal (one loop over typed, ledger-persisted turns; native JSON-schema tools; Guardian as the mandatory, non-configurable PreToolUse hook; token-pressure compaction; declarative agent definitions; in-process sub-agents; one Stop hook replacing the regex police). Sequence: the three judges' consensus, which the harness proposal itself did not have: physical-safety closure and zero-contract wires in week one, native tools and streaming inside the first quarter behind per-provider capability flags, memory and self/world projections next, the growth merge last, and the agent/ + llm/ package consolidation deferred to the end and gated by the eval suite. Grafts: cognitive's fact store with supersession, Beta posteriors, Thompson sampling, WAITING states and checkpoint critic; systems' evals package as the bless gate, safety tiers 0-3, spans/samples telemetry out of the decision log, deadline in the envelope, tokens/usd/wall budgets; embodied's HomeRule recompute, requester on proposals, People model, Initiative as the single path for unprompted speech, streaming STT as primary. Verified against the code on 2026-09-18: tool.registered ships schema_ref='' and no args_schema (execution/service.py:167-171); cognition/service.py:358 passes tools=None and every adapter drops it; nothing under simorgh/guardian/ imports classify_call and kernel/service.py:203 defaults irreversible_requires_human to False; orchestration/config.py has reground_every_steps=0, delegation=False, escalate_from_attempt=0; docs/findings/2026-09-15 measured re-grounding every 6 as no gain with ~2x step exhaustion and sized run-to-run noise (3/21 vs 9/25) larger than any arm gap; StreamingSynthesiser, StreamingPlayer, synthesise_stream and stt/sherpa_stream.py exist and receive nothing streamed; ledger/backends/sqlite.py exists with (stream, seq) CAS; interface/service.py:943 mints a uuid per typed line; memory/store.py WorkingMemory is in-process, never durable, and unfed.

what_sim_got_right.decision: The action path is structural, not policy: only Guardian subscribes to action.proposed, only Execution to action.approved, approval is an HMAC over (action_id | tool | sha256(args) | expires) that Execution re-verifies, and kernel/selfcheck.py proves the wire (forged token refused, pause denies) before any work runs. Corrigibility (pause/stop) is rule one.
what_sim_got_right.why_it_matters_for_the_future: Every pattern this synthesis adds (native tool_use blocks, parallel calls, MCP servers, sub-agents, skills, a self-improvement loop, physical actuation) produces more ways for a model to reach an effect. A chokepoint enforced by bus topology survives all of them unchanged: N tool_use blocks in one turn become N proposals, a child agent cannot inherit an approval, and a learned policy is just another proposal. All four proposals and all three judges agree this is the one decision that lets everything else be swapped.
what_sim_got_right.keep_or_strengthen: Keep byte-for-byte. Make it the harness's mandatory PreToolUse hook (a ToolResult for an external tool can only be constructed from an action.result). Strengthen on three axes the judges agreed on: (1) Guardian recomputes physical reversibility itself from the proposal's args via contracts/home/policy.classify_call instead of trusting proposal.reversibility (verified gap); (2) every decision records its rule, tier and posture on the turn so approvals/denials per tier per day is a number; (3) protected subjects extend to agents/ definitions, the hooks list, the rules/skills roots the growth loop writes to, and the evals gate config, so the loop can never loosen its own gate.

what_sim_got_right.decision: Append-only Ledger as the only truth with projections rebuilt from it; task:<id> streams with lease heartbeat; orchestration/resume.py distinguishing a crash (continue the attempt) from a retry (fresh budget, carried note, kept edits); learning/competence.py CompetenceTable as a real fold over learn:outcomes.
what_sim_got_right.why_it_matters_for_the_future: Checkpoint-and-resume is the defining property of long-horizon agents and Sim already has the substrate. Every addition here (session transcripts, a fact store with supersession, Beta posteriors, an environment-state table, a policy store) is one more projection over streams that already exist; nothing needs re-platforming. The ledger of transcripts is also the raw material for every future eval and distillation.
what_sim_got_right.keep_or_strengthen: Strengthen: the session transcript itself becomes a stream (session:<id>, typed turns) so resume, replay, compaction, evals-from-transcripts and the trajectory check read one thing; the Self Model and memory indexes become durable projections with snapshots instead of boot-time rebuilds. Fix the cost side separately: per-turn appends, traces threaded per session/task, telemetry out of the fsync'd decision log (systems). Keep fsync-per-append for decision streams.

what_sim_got_right.decision: 'Only contracts is shared' enforced by an AST boundary test, 175 typed topics with SUBSCRIBE_ONLY_BY/PUBLISH_ONLY_BY, one package per subsystem, Kernel as the sole composition root; the Tool protocol already carries name, description, read_only, reversibility and args_schema in-process (contracts/protocols.py:195-200).
what_sim_got_right.why_it_matters_for_the_future: This is what makes the whole programme incremental: Memory's internals, the growth merge, the ContextBuilder and the eventual package moves are all invisible to neighbours as long as topics are preserved, and coding agents can work on modules in parallel (the creator's actual style). Native tool calling is a serialisation of a field that already exists on every tool, not a redesign.
what_sim_got_right.keep_or_strengthen: Keep. Two corrections the judges made to the proposals: args_schema does NOT cross the bus today (schema_ref is ''), so shipping ToolSpec is a contract addition; and the boundary was never the reason descriptions did not reach the model. Add to contracts: Turn/Block/ToolSpec/Plan/Fact/People/Policy schemas, and the Llm/MemoryReader/SelfModelReader/PersonaReader protocols that the Kernel injects in single mode exactly as it injects bus and ledger clients.

what_sim_got_right.decision: The long-run machinery is already built behind switches: profiles with per-kind allowlists, budgets and scaffolds; skills in the open SKILL.md format with catalog-then-load; in-process delegate with fresh context and summary-only return; a structured ProgressNote (goal/done/learned/next/open questions); parallel read-only batches; tier escalation via cognition's routes map and session.py::_tier. All off in the live config (orchestration/config.py, no [cognition] routes).
what_sim_got_right.why_it_matters_for_the_future: These are the 2026 harness patterns (agent definitions as permission modes, procedural memory as files, sub-agents with isolated context, structured compaction, model routing by purpose) reached from the other side, one live-caught incident at a time, and the scaffold content is hard-won. The judges' finding is that the cheapest capability gains in the whole plan are config and two producer wires.
what_sim_got_right.keep_or_strengthen: Turn on in week one what the data supports: delegation for research, parallel_read_tools=4 (arm 25 halved step exhaustion on L3 with no score loss), escalate_from_attempt=1, a purpose->tier routes map, and the model's ProgressNote as the carried note between attempts. Do NOT turn on reground_every_steps=3 as the cognitive proposal asked: the 2026-09-15 finding measured every-6 as no gain with roughly double 'step budget exhausted'. Then evolve: profiles+scaffolds into Guardian-protected agents/<name>.md files; delegate into a Task built-in; ProgressNote into the second layer of token-pressure compaction; skills into the growth loop's primary artifact.

what_sim_got_right.decision: Cognition's production plumbing: ordered failover with per-provider rolling budgets replayed from the ledger, estimated-cost check before dialling, shared deadline slices so the last candidate still gets time, cooldown circuit breaker, truncation retry, billable-on-failure accounting, purpose filters, image-capability filter, and a per-call provider order parameter.
what_sim_got_right.why_it_matters_for_the_future: Per-step routing by purpose, tier, context size and latency budget is a policy layered on exactly these primitives; most harnesses get the operational details wrong. Nothing here needs replacing to add streaming, native tool dialects, prompt-cache-aware ordering or per-purpose reasoning effort.
what_sim_got_right.keep_or_strengthen: Keep as the core of the LLM gateway. Add: provider capability flags (supports_tools, supports_streaming, supports_images, context_window), dialect adapters, stream(), a direct Anthropic Messages API adapter as a second native-tool provider, token counting with cached_input_tokens reported, and routing keyed by (purpose, tier, context bucket, latency budget) with route quality fed from the eval suite.

what_sim_got_right.decision: An independent critic and a mechanical floor for self-modification: Verification with eleven mechanical checks cheapest-first, a model checklist only at LIGHT+ rigor, trajectory scoring, an explicit insufficient_evidence outcome, and a measured decision to keep the LLM answer reviewer off for research; worktree landing = rebase + whole-suite gate + fast-forward; simloader boots through a curated core set and rolls back to the last sim-good tag.
what_sim_got_right.why_it_matters_for_the_future: Critic loops where an oracle exists and A/B images with an external judge are what make 'continuously improving without becoming less safe' more than a slogan. Few personal agents have any of this; Sim has all three.
what_sim_got_right.keep_or_strengthen: Keep. Make Verification the Stop hook of verify:true agents with a bounded revise loop, the checkpoint critic at every progress note against per-node acceptance criteria (cognitive), and the scorer inside the evals package (systems). Make simloader's bless gate the evals suite, not CORE_TESTS alone, with a post-handoff watch phase counting SLO breaches.

what_sim_got_right.decision: Honesty doctrine in the wire: a floor never fabricates; non_answer is distinct from rejection; 'memory could not be consulted' is a different prompt from 'no memory matched'; truncation is announced; distillation refuses untraceable specifics; failovers and denials are logged; a floor-answered benchmark case is skipped, not scored; 'ambiguity is refused, never guessed' and 'unknown is a real answer' in the physical and voice layers.
what_sim_got_right.why_it_matters_for_the_future: Agents fail worst when a tool result or a memory says something false, and household agents lose trust on one confident wrong act. This doctrine carries straight into ToolResult{is_error}, compaction stubs, fact provenance, presence beliefs rendered as distributions, and trustworthy eval baselines.
what_sim_got_right.keep_or_strengthen: Keep as a written rule for every ToolResult, every compaction stub ('[result of read_file, 41,203 chars, ref session:x#12]' is honest; a silent cut is not), every fact (source_refs, superseded_by), every self-model figure (sample count), and every percept (confidence and source rendered, never the bare claim).

what_sim_got_right.decision: Measure-from-the-running-system discipline: tools/trial.py and trial_suite.py (single watched real tasks), observer waves, docs/findings/, a benchmark unit that drives task.create through the whole bus, and the retrospective's own conclusion that the 90k-line unit suite asserts code shape and missed every real blocker; the 2026-09-15 finding that run-to-run noise exceeds arm gaps.
what_sim_got_right.why_it_matters_for_the_future: Eval-driven development is the only way one person can re-architect the loop without regressing, and the project learned this a year earlier than most teams. It is also the only safe gate for a self-improvement loop.
what_sim_got_right.keep_or_strengthen: Promote it to the merge gate before any behaviour change (all three judges): trial suite + benchmark unit + a 30-turn household recall scenario + a kill-and-resume trial, >=3 repeats with a bootstrap CI before any switch flips, results recorded in docs/findings/. Later fold into simorgh/evals as simloader's bless gate.

what_sim_got_right.decision: Self-knowledge and exploration as estimated quantities and diversity by construction: a Laplace-smoothed, shrinkage-corrected competence table with calibration bins; Curiosity sampling the area from real inventories with a drive-weighted softmax before asking the model to propose within it.
what_sim_got_right.why_it_matters_for_the_future: A self model with uncertainty and directed exploration that does not collapse onto the model's favourite topic are the right primitives for calibrated escalation, honest 'I am bad at X', and idle-time improvement. They are under-consumed (compute_gaps returns [], strategy.suggest has no caller, the gap drive sees a constant), not wrong.
what_sim_got_right.keep_or_strengthen: Keep the mechanisms, change the inputs: Beta(alpha, beta) posteriors with exponential forgetting per task_type and (task_type, strategy); compute_gaps from them; Thompson sampling over posteriors replacing the softmax over a constant; target space extended from repo areas to household unknowns, stale facts and unexercised skills; competence fed from verify-backed outcomes and eval pass rates as separate weighted sources (systems' correction), never chat self-reports.

what_sim_got_right.decision: The household design decisions already in contracts and docs: 'Sim speaks to Home Assistant, not to devices' with hard safety in HA; a pure, pessimistic classify_call; a household roster and places in contracts; per-person memory tags on voice turns; turn-taking as a pure state machine with barge-in gated by an echo tracker fed from what was actually played.
what_sim_got_right.why_it_matters_for_the_future: A hub with a uniform entity model, a rules engine that survives the agent being down, and a testable full-duplex turn manager are the established shape for an embodied household agent; multi-person memory partitioning is what most frameworks lack.
what_sim_got_right.keep_or_strengthen: Keep the decisions; connect their other halves in order of safety: Guardian recomputing classify_call and a separate physical posture first (no HA needed), a People model joining identities across channels second, world:home and presence from events already on the bus third, HA's event bridge, standing intents and routine mining only when the creator installs HA. Extend the person tag to every channel.

where_it_diverges_from_the_future.current: Tool calls are parsed out of free text by a marker protocol (cognition/parser.py: one string per MARKER: line, a JSON second-line hack, a hand-maintained _CODE_BEARING_MARKERS set); every adapter accepts tools= and drops it, cognition/service.py:358 passes tools=None, ProviderResponse.tool_calls is filled only by the parser; tool.registered ships description but schema_ref='' and no args_schema; MCP tools with more than one property are uncallable (mcp_single_arg_key returns None). session.py polices the prose with seven regex families, each a live-caught incident.
where_it_diverges_from_the_future.future_pattern: Native structured tool use: ToolSpec{name, description, input_schema} rendered per provider dialect (OpenAI-style functions for Together/Ollama, Anthropic tool blocks, Gemini function declarations); typed tool_use blocks with ids validated against the schema; tool_result blocks keyed by id; several calls per turn; the harness never parses prose for intent.
where_it_diverges_from_the_future.gap: Root of the police family, the 246-tool-runs-without-a-write incident, first-line argument truncation, the MCP ceiling and a measurable BFCL ceiling. Resolution across proposals: land it early (stages 2-3, harness/systems timing, not cognitive's stage 6) but behind a per-provider capability flag with markers as the fallback dialect, flipped per model only after BFCL and the trial suite beat markers on the model actually in use (GLM-5.3-Flash is unmeasured), with VOICE_CHAT as the bounded first flip (embodied) and a direct Anthropic API adapter so the harness is not judged by one model. The police stay alive on marker-only paths (the Claude Code CLI wrapper is the live day-cap failover) and each is deleted only when its counter reads zero for a bless cycle.

where_it_diverges_from_the_future.current: A CLI chat turn is a throwaway Session (interface/service.py:943 mints a uuid per line); no transcript; continuity is three similarity recalls under 0.25 s that the code itself documents losing (falcon/sparrow, two birthdays). WorkingMemory exists in memory/store.py, in-process only, and nothing feeds it.
where_it_diverges_from_the_future.future_pattern: One persistent, resumable session per (channel, person) with an append-only typed transcript (session:<id> ledger stream) that is compacted, not discarded; memory recall augments the transcript instead of standing in for it.
where_it_diverges_from_the_future.gap: 'What did I just say' fails by construction, chat cannot be compacted, and restart loses everything. Resolution: the ledger stream is the destination (harness/systems; blueprint 4.4 and the persistent-daemon intent) because resume, evals-from-transcripts, audit and the trajectory check all read it; cognitive's one-day wire (feed WorkingMemory from turn.completed keyed by (person, channel), render six turns before the memory block) is the correct stage-0 stopgap and must not become the design.

where_it_diverges_from_the_future.current: Prompt assembly is split between cognition/assembler.py (constitution, persona voice, self summary, task_rules) and orchestration/context.py (memory block, task, carried notes, messages); each block is a bus request with a 0.25-2 s timeout, silently omitted on timeout ('the normal case, not an edge' per the code); block order changes per turn; the whole prompt rides the bus as a think payload and every message gets a trace stream; the 300 s handler timeout was once every task's wall budget.
where_it_diverges_from_the_future.future_pattern: One ContextBuilder inside the loop with an explicit token budget per section, a stable cacheable prefix (constitution -> persona -> self summary -> agent body -> tool specs -> skills catalog), per-turn material (memory recall, time, environment) inside the latest user turn, and the model call as an injected in-process gateway in single mode.
where_it_diverges_from_the_future.gap: No prefix is cacheable, blocks vanish under load, and a synchronous streaming large-payload call is the wrong thing to put on a bus. Resolution (all three judges): take harness's behavioural fixes now, inside existing packages: one ContextBuilder in orchestration absorbing assembler's block order and context.py's memory block, and contracts-defined Llm/MemoryReader/SelfModelReader/PersonaReader protocols injected by the Kernel (in-process objects in single mode, bus-backed adapters with real timeouts in local-multi/aws so principle 4.2 and the boundary test survive); cognition.think stays on the bus for Planning, Memory consolidation and Verification. The physical agent/ + llm/ package move is the last stage, not the fourth.

where_it_diverges_from_the_future.current: Memory recall is hashed bag-of-words (sha256 token buckets, 256 dims) because the real embedder cost 24.9 s on first call; paraphrases score 0.0; flag_contradictions penalises the correction and the error symmetrically by 0.5; supersession is a prose header asking the model to prefer later lines; semantic memory is free-text distillations; per-person tags exist only on voice turns.
where_it_diverges_from_the_future.future_pattern: Tiered memory: working (the session transcript), episodic (turn records with real dense embeddings persisted at store time), semantic (a fact store with first-class supersession and provenance), procedural (skills); hybrid BM25 + dense retrieval with reciprocal rank fusion and recency/person/confidence rerank; retrieval also exposed to the model as a tool.
where_it_diverges_from_the_future.gap: Recall quality is the ceiling on 'knows the family across months'; a correction should win by data structure, not by the model noticing which line is later. Resolution: all four agree on the target; schedule it early (cognitive's stage 2, not harness's stage 7) because it sits behind unchanged memory.retrieve/store contracts, does not depend on the tool protocol, and is what the family feels daily. Embed in a boot thread and persist vectors; hashing remains the cold floor; speculative recall on percept takes it off the voice critical path.

where_it_diverges_from_the_future.current: One action per step except read-only batches; budgets are steps per attempt (cap 200) and 'step budget exhausted' is the leading benchmark failure; re-grounding by step count is built and measured as no gain; tool results cut at 8,000 chars by a class constant; no wall-clock or dollar budget; no streaming anywhere (voice full response 4-17 s while StreamingSynthesiser/StreamingPlayer wait for input they never receive).
where_it_diverges_from_the_future.future_pattern: A step is one model turn with N tool_use blocks (reads concurrent, writes serialised); budgets in tokens, USD and wall-clock with the step cap as a sanity bound; compaction by measured token pressure (age old tool results into re-fetchable stubs, then a structured progress note) for every session kind; provider streaming with deltas to surfaces and sentence-chunked TTS; a deadline in the envelope shrunk per hop.
where_it_diverges_from_the_future.gap: Long tasks spend steps on things that should be one turn and hit context_too_large before a note fires; first audio is the family-felt latency. Resolution: harness's token-pressure trigger over cognitive's every-3 (contradicted by the 2026-09-15 data); the ProgressNote shape is kept by all; streaming lands in the first quarter beside native tools (three of four proposals) with embodied's streaming STT as primary and systems' deadline field so the result is attributable; moving engines out of process waits for spans to show a stall.

where_it_diverges_from_the_future.current: The growth layer is open at every seam: Learning's PatchPipeline is unreachable (no publisher for learn.pipeline.run, draft_candidate not registered, health reports UNREACHABLE); Reflection drafts skills nobody promotes and writes critiques nobody reads back; Curiosity's gap drive reads a constant because compute_gaps returns []; strategy.suggest has no caller; the Self Model is in-memory per process and capabilities['tools'] is never written; benchmarks gate nothing.
where_it_diverges_from_the_future.future_pattern: One eval-driven loop over a versioned policy store: estimate (posteriors) -> diagnose (failure clusters) -> propose a typed artifact (task-type rule, skill, routing change, code patch) -> evaluate on a held-out case set in a worktree -> adopt through the gate as a committed, Guardian-protected file -> monitor and retire; competence from eval pass rates; a Self Model that is a fold of ledger streams.
where_it_diverges_from_the_future.gap: Three subsystems each own a fragment of one loop and nothing changes future behaviour from experience. Resolution: merge into one growth/ package (all four); cognitive's policy-artifact schema is the container; systems' rule that the promotion signal is eval pass rate, not self-reported outcomes; harness's rule that the loop's only output is a proposal through the gate; judge 1's objection to live prompt self-modification is dissolved by landing rules and skills as committed files under a protected directory, A/B'd on the trial suite before they are active, never rendered from a mutable store. Delete PatchPipeline. Last stage, because it needs the eval sets every earlier stage builds.

where_it_diverges_from_the_future.current: One auto-approve knob (SIMORGH_GUARDIAN_AUTO_APPROVE, on by default since 2026-09-07; kernel/service.py sets irreversible_requires_human=False) covers a git commit in a worktree and a camera siren alike; Guardian trusts the proposer's reversibility label (nothing in simorgh/guardian/ imports classify_call, ReversibilityRule reads proposal.reversibility); Proposal carries proposed_by and origin but no requester person, role or channel; identity is per channel and never joined.
where_it_diverges_from_the_future.future_pattern: Explicit safety tiers computed from reversibility x scope x origin x blast radius, tier 3 (external, physical, financial) human-gated in every posture; physical reversibility recomputed at the gate from typed args; requester identity on every proposal so rules can be per person; loosening human-only; tightening automatic.
where_it_diverges_from_the_future.gap: A better loop reaches more effects faster under the same collapsed gate. Resolution (judges unanimous): embodied's HomeRule recompute, [guardian.physical] posture with auto_approve=false, requester field defaulting to 'unknown', and a self-check drill (a mislabelled lock.unlock must be escalated) land in week one, purely additive and needing no Home Assistant; systems' tier model is the general frame folded in at the same stage as typed args; harness's Guardian protection of agents/, hooks and the eval gate completes it.

where_it_diverges_from_the_future.current: Telemetry lives in the decision log at git-commit durability: trace:<id> streams per message (88k files), metrics:history 114 MB, curiosity:ticks 43 MB, persona:state 17 MB, fsync per append; retention is per-file deletion; 'why was that turn 9 s' is unanswerable without joining files; every timeout (voice reply 95 s, TTS stall 20 s, chat 90 s, bus request 30 s) is a local guard with no deadline travelling in the message.
where_it_diverges_from_the_future.future_pattern: Decision streams event-sourced with fsync; spans (one root per turn/task, children per think/guardian/tool/verify/stt/tts) and samples (metrics, ticks, mood) in sqlite tables with per-root sampling, row-level retention and downsampling; a deadline in the envelope; per-stage budgets with breaches as span events.
where_it_diverges_from_the_future.gap: Disk grows ~700 MB/week from streams no decision depends on and no latency work is attributable. Resolution: systems' split is right and lands at stage 1 (after the safety fix, not as stage 0), using the existing sqlite backend for the telemetry tables only; trace_id threading per session/task plus the existing retention and per-type sampling remove most of the 88k streams without a backend switch; flipping the decision log's default backend to sqlite is a migration with its own eval, deferred to the final stage.

where_it_diverges_from_the_future.current: No household world state or joined identity: the only 'room' is a 16-line deque in voice/session.py lost on restart; World Model facets are codebase-shaped; presence is not modelled; camera.event and tv.state are published and folded nowhere the model can read; unprompted speech comes from four uncoordinated sources (curiosity/persona sharing, execution/vision.py announcing from inside Execution, reminders, backchannel) none of which knows who is present or asleep.
where_it_diverges_from_the_future.future_pattern: A world:home projection (entity states, per-(person, area) presence belief with decay, situation facts rendered with staleness -> 'unknown'); a People model with one person_id across channels, role tier, permissions and memory namespace; one Initiative policy scoring urgency x relevance minus interruption cost, every delivery a guarded action.
where_it_diverges_from_the_future.gap: Sim can wake a sleeping child to describe the postman and cannot decide to text the owner instead. Resolution: start these from events already on the bus (camera, TV, voice speaker id, calendar) without waiting for Home Assistant, as World Model facets and one small Initiative module rather than embodied's six new packages; the HA bridge, standing intents, routine mining and Frigate are an ongoing final stage contingent on the creator's hardware decision.

where_it_diverges_from_the_future.current: Planning decomposes only into patch/research steps under simorgh/ by a numbered-list regex; a project is COMPLETED when children exist and nothing waits on them; no acceptance criteria per node, no waiting states, no wake-ups; the checkpoint critic runs only at task end; verdicts from one sample.
where_it_diverges_from_the_future.future_pattern: Typed Plan artifacts with acceptance criteria and depends_on; project sessions that spawn in-process child sub-agents and await them by event (never through the queue); WAITING(until|event|human) with scheduler wake-ups; the critic at every progress note; majority vote of cheap samples for yes/no verdicts.
where_it_diverges_from_the_future.gap: Decomposition depth > 0 has never once produced a child that ran to completion. Resolution: harness's Task built-in over agent definitions plus cognitive's WAITING status and checkpoint critic, in one long-horizon stage after the session stream exists.

where_it_diverges_from_the_future.current: Tests: 447 files / 90k lines asserting code shape; the 8-minute gate is unit tests; the retrospective says they missed every real blocker; the trial suite, benchmark unit and observer kit exist as tools, not a package, and are not what bless runs.
where_it_diverges_from_the_future.future_pattern: Eval-driven development: capability suites with automatic scoring, >=3 repeats and a CI, a small deterministic replay tier for harness-only changes, unit tests only where logic is pure; the eval suite is the release gate.
where_it_diverges_from_the_future.gap: The migration cannot be done safely with the current gate. Resolution: a small gate promoted in week one (harness/cognitive, not systems' stage 3), grown into simorgh/evals at stage 4; systems' FixtureProvider keyed by prompt hash is adopted only in the form that survives prompt edits (replay keyed by session turn seq and tool_use id, not by prompt text).

where_it_diverges_from_the_future.current: interface/dispatch.py is 2,234 lines of command dispatch, a second vocabulary from the model's tools bridged by a sim_command string tunnel; Voice's session.py (1,961 lines) carries dialogue policy, room memory and identity regexes beside audio; HTTP binds 0.0.0.0 with auth only if a token is set.
where_it_diverges_from_the_future.future_pattern: Operator commands the model needs are tools with schemas; the TUI renders the session stream; channels are thin person-resolving adapters; auth on by default for non-loopback binds.
where_it_diverges_from_the_future.gap: Two vocabularies drift and voice/session.py is the home of every per-turn-fact-in-session-state bug. Resolution: auth default in week one (one line); dispatch shrink and the channels/admin split only after sessions are persistent and native tools exist (all judges), since both change what the TUI renders.

target_architecture.one_paragraph: Keep the substrate (Bus, Ledger, Kernel, Contracts) and the safety path (Guardian, Execution with its token verifier, Verification, worktree landing, simloader) as they are, and close the two verified safety gaps in week one: Guardian recomputes physical reversibility from typed args on its own posture, and every proposal carries who asked. The thinking path becomes the harness proposal's loop, built inside the existing orchestration and cognition packages first and physically consolidated last: one loop for every session kind (chat, voice, task, project, sub-agent) over a typed transcript persisted as a session:<id> ledger stream; native JSON-schema tools rendered per provider dialect behind capability flags with the marker protocol frozen as a fallback; N tool_use blocks per turn (reads concurrent, writes serialised) each proposed to Guardian as the mandatory PreToolUse hook; one ContextBuilder with a cacheable prefix and per-turn material inside the latest user turn; token-pressure compaction that ages tool results into honest re-fetchable stubs before writing the existing ProgressNote; streaming deltas to the TUI and to Voice's already-built sentence synthesiser; hooks (SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse=Guardian, PostToolUse, Stop, PreCompact) declared per Guardian-protected agents/<name>.md definition; a Task built-in for in-process sub-agents; budgets in tokens, USD and wall-clock. Cognition becomes an LLM gateway (capabilities, dialects, streaming, routing by purpose x tier x context x latency, budgets) reachable in-process through a contracts protocol in single mode and over the bus otherwise. Memory becomes four real tiers with a warmed dense embedder, persisted vectors, BM25 + dense fusion and a fact store with supersession. World Model becomes two durable projections: a Self Model of Beta posteriors, calibration and tool reliability, and a world:home of entity states, presence beliefs and situation facts, plus the People store. Guardian gains tiers 0-3 with tier 3 human-always. Telemetry (spans, samples) leaves the decision log for sqlite tables and a deadline travels in the envelope. Learning, Reflection and Curiosity merge into one growth/ package whose only output is a proposal through the gate, adopted as committed protected files when a held-out eval improves. Benchmark, the trial harness and the observer kit merge into evals/, which is simloader's bless gate. Nothing acts on the world except through action.proposed; nothing loosens a gate except a human.

modules.name: orchestration (the Harness; renamed agent/ only in the final stage)
modules.from: keep simorgh/orchestration; absorbs cognition/assembler.py's block order and context.py into one ContextBuilder; profiles.py + scaffolds.py become the loader for agents/<name>.md; session.py sheds the regex police as native paths make each unreachable
modules.responsibility: Run one loop for every session kind: build context, stream the model, execute tool_use blocks through Guardian, append typed turns to the session stream, compact under token pressure, delegate, stop; resume any session from its stream.
key_algorithms_or_methods: Turn model in contracts: Session{id, agent, channel, person_id, parent_id, depth, budget{turns, tokens, usd, wall_s}, state}; Turn{seq, role, blocks[], ts, meta{provider, model, in/out tokens, cached_input_tokens, cost}}; Block = Text | ToolUse{id, name, input} | ToolResult{tool_use_id, content, is_error, ref, bytes_total} | Image{ref}. Persisted as session:<id> with session.turn.appended (per turn, not per block), session.compacted{summary, dropped_seq_range}, session.snapshot; state = fold; interface stops minting a uuid per typed line and keeps one session per (channel, person).

Loop: check pause/cancel -> ContextBuilder.build -> llm.stream -> assistant turn -> if no tool_use: Stop hooks -> done; else partition blocks: read-only set via asyncio.gather over propose_and_await, mutating list sequential in block order stopping at first is_error; one tool turn with N ToolResults in original order. Budgets in turns, tokens, USD, wall-clock; the step cap kept only as a sanity bound (chosen over cognitive's steps-plus-checkpoints because 'step budget exhausted' is the leading benchmark failure and a step is arbitrary once a turn carries N blocks).

PreToolUse hook, mandatory and not configurable: ToolUse -> action.proposed{action_id = tool_use.id, tool, args schema-validated, scope, reversibility, requester{person_id, role, channel, verified}, session_id, agent} -> await approved|denied|needs_human -> action.result -> ToolResult. Denial becomes ToolResult{is_error, 'denied by <rule>: <reason>'}; needs_human parks the session (awaiting_human event on the stream) and resumes on ui.reply. Only effect-free built-ins (Task, use_skill, memory_search, recall_result, plan) bypass Guardian, exactly as delegate/use_skill do today.

ContextBuilder (decided in 07 section 3.2 'one owner for context assembly'): fixed prefix order constitution -> persona voice -> self summary -> user/person digest -> agent body -> tool specs -> skills catalog, then the compacted transcript; per-turn material (memory recall, world-now, time, notices) as a block at the head of the latest user turn so the cached prefix survives; explicit token budget per section; unavailable sections rendered as an honest note (kept from context.py). Reads persona/self/memory through Kernel-injected protocols (in-process in single mode; bus-backed adapters with real timeouts in local-multi/aws), not 0.25 s bus RPCs.

Compactor driven by measured tokens against the provider's window: layer A at age_results_at (0.7): ToolResult content older than keep_recent_turns replaced by '[result of <tool> <args-preview>, <N> chars, ref session:<id>#<seq>]' re-fetchable via recall_result; layer B at summarize_at (0.85): today's ProgressNote (goal/done/learned/next/open questions) by a cheap purpose over everything but the protected prefix and last M turns; chat uses a 'conversation so far' flavour preserving facts about people; PreCompact hook lets the agent definition add 'preserve X'. Chosen over cognitive's reground_every_steps=3 because docs/findings/2026-09-15 measured step-count re-grounding as no gain with ~2x step exhaustion; the note's shape is kept by all four.

Agent definitions agents/<name>.md: frontmatter {tools allowlist with globs ('mcp:*', 'cam_*'), model_tier, max_turns, max_tokens, max_cost_usd, max_wall_s, max_parallel_tools, verify, isolation: fresh|fork, compaction thresholds, hooks list, channels}, body = scaffold text; Guardian-protected; today's CHAT/PATCH/RESEARCH/SKILL/VOICE_CHAT/PLAN become six files.

Delegation: built-in Task{agent, brief, isolation, budget} -> child Session on its own stream, run in-process (never via the task queue: the documented workers=1 deadlock), depth <= max_depth, concurrency <= max_children, summary-only return bounded as a ToolResult, tier escalation on helper failure kept; projects are parent sessions that spawn children per plan step and await them by task.completed/failed events with Planning's DAG ordering.

Hooks per agent definition: SessionStart (resume from stream, carried ProgressNote), UserPromptSubmit (speculative memory/world-now recall issued on percept, person/channel tagging), PreToolUse (Guardian, budget, pause; cannot be removed), PostToolUse (side-effect record: uncommitted files, created paths, write-watch), Stop (one generic check: 'final text claims an effect and this turn has no successful ToolResult from a mutating tool' -> bounce once naming the tools that could do it; Verification for verify:true agents with max_revisions), PreCompact.

Streaming: consume llm.stream Delta{text | tool_use_start | tool_use_input_json | stop}; publish session.delta on the bus (bus-only, never ledgered) for TUI, HTTP feed and Voice; the completed turn is what reaches the ledger; cancellation on system.stop records a truncated turn honestly.

Resume: resume.py's crash-vs-retry logic kept, reading the session stream; the model's ProgressNote is the carried note across attempts (cognitive's independent idea, grafted without its trigger), replacing the mechanical 220-char-per-step summary.

Regex police: kept alive on every marker-dialect provider path (the Claude Code CLI wrapper is the live day-cap failover); each function deleted only when its span counter reads zero for a bless cycle on native paths; invented_markers, unhonoured_marker and _transcript_echo survive on the fallback dialect indefinitely.
modules.interfaces: Consumes: task.available, percept.text.received (with person_id, channel, device, addressee), voice.transcript, action.approved|denied|needs_human|result, tool.registered, system.pause|stop|resume, ui.reply, task.wake, task.answer. Produces: action.proposed, task.started|step|progress|checkpoint|waiting|completed|failed|blocked, turn.completed, session.delta (bus-only), memory.store. Injected protocols: Llm, MemoryReader, SelfModelReader, PersonaReader, Ledger, Bus. Handle: BFCL/BFCL-parallel, steps and cost per resolved case, correction turns per 100 turns, resume-after-kill success, context tokens per turn plateau.

modules.name: cognition (LLM gateway; renamed llm/ only in the final stage)
modules.from: keep simorgh/cognition; providers/, router.py, budget.py, tokens.py, api.py stay; assembler.py's block order moves to the ContextBuilder; parser.py demoted to the marker fallback dialect; compaction.py's layers reused by the Compactor
modules.responsibility: Turn (system, messages, tools, budget, purpose, tier, deadline) into a streamed response in the right provider dialect with routing, failover, budgets and cost accounting; no prompt assembly, no parsing of prose except on the fallback dialect.
key_algorithms_or_methods: Provider protocol: capabilities{supports_tools, supports_streaming, supports_images, context_window, cache_prefix} + stream(system, messages, tools, max_tokens, timeout, reasoning_effort) -> AsyncIterator[Delta]; complete() derived from stream; ProviderResponse.tool_calls filled natively.

Dialect adapters: Together (OpenAI-compatible functions + streaming; per-model tool quality measured on BFCL before any flip), a direct Anthropic Messages API adapter when a key is configured (tool_use/tool_result blocks, streaming, prompt caching) as the second native-tool provider, Gemini function declarations, Ollama chat tools for capable models; the Claude Code CLI wrapper stays text-only, supports_tools=false, marker dialect; the floor never emits a tool_use.

Router kept (ordered failover, shared deadline slices, cooldown, truncation retry, billable-on-failure, purpose and image filters); routes keyed by (purpose, tier, context bucket, latency budget) -> ordered candidates + reasoning_effort (systems); purpose->tier map in config with escalate_from_attempt=1 in week one; strong tier for plan/decompose/critique/verify-on-failure, cheap tier for reground/consolidate/classify/ack/addressee; majority vote of 3 cheap samples only for yes/no verdicts (cognitive).
Deadline taken from the envelope and shrunk per hop; token counting per provider where offered, estimate otherwise; cached_input_tokens reported; prefix-stability hints exposed to the ContextBuilder.

contracts.protocols.Llm implemented in-process and injected by the Kernel in single mode; a bus-backed adapter implements the same protocol in local-multi/aws; cognition.think stays on the bus for Planning, Memory consolidation and Verification (resolution of the bus-vs-injection disagreement: harness's diagnosis, cognitive/systems' packaging).
modules.interfaces: Llm protocol (stream/complete/count_tokens/tiers) to orchestration and growth; cognition.think on the bus for other subsystems, payload gaining tools, tier, vote, deadline, stream; produces cognition.provider.status, budget metrics. Handle: tokens and dollars per purpose with cache hit rate; TTFT per provider.

modules.name: memory
modules.from: keep simorgh/memory; rebuild store.py, recall.py, embed.py/embedders.py, consolidation.py behind unchanged topics
modules.responsibility: Four tiers: working (the session transcript, owned by orchestration), episodic (turn records indexed at write time), semantic (a fact store with supersession), procedural (skills and adopted policies); hybrid retrieval; a model-callable search tool.
key_algorithms_or_methods: Embeddings: the existing sentence-transformers adapter (MiniLM-class, ~384 dims) loaded in a background thread at boot; embed at store time and persist vectors as a projection keyed by ref (array('f') per record, or sqlite blobs); recall never waits on embedding; hashing stays the floor until warm and forever when the optional dependency is absent; each record stores which embedder produced its vector.

Index: numpy float32 matrix per kind with brute-force cosine (sub-10 ms to ~100k records; ANN only past ~200k); BM25 by extending the existing inverted index in recall.py with tf and doc length (stdlib); reciprocal rank fusion; rerank by recency half-life, person tag, confidence; optional cheap-model rerank of the top 20 for chat.

Fact store (semantic tier) memory:facts: Fact{id, person_scope, subject, predicate, object, valid_from, valid_to, superseded_by, confidence, source_refs (session:<id>#<seq>)}; extraction at consolidation by a cheap purpose returning JSON triples each with the quoted span it came from; the existing untraceable() check applied per triple; supersession by key (person_scope, subject, predicate) so a correction wins by structure and recall renders 'X (was Y until <date>)'; replaces flag_contradictions' symmetric 0.5 penalty (stream kept read-only for history).

Entity-linked facts block: names of known people/devices/places in the query pull their current facts into a small block rendered before the episodic block; per-person digest (~150 tokens) regenerated from facts at sleep and delivered as a protected block when that person speaks, replacing persona/user_model.py's two regexes.

Speculative recall: orchestration issues memory and world-now lookups on percept.text.received (voice: on the STT partial) in parallel with session setup; budget ~1 s once off the critical path; the explicit 'memory could not be consulted' note kept.

Agentic recall: memory_search{query, kinds, person, since} as a built-in tool; consolidation on system.tick.sleep kept (episodic -> facts + skill candidates) with the 'answered instead of summarised' guard; forgetting by retention score, never facts with live links; person:<id> namespace on every channel's turns, not only voice.
modules.interfaces: Unchanged memory.store/retrieve/forget/stored/consolidated; add memory.fact.stored/superseded and a facts field on memory.retrieve.reply; MemoryReader protocol in-process. Handle: recall@k and correction-wins rate on the 30-turn household scenario built from the ledger's own failures (falcon/sparrow, the birthday correction).

modules.name: guardian
modules.from: keep simorgh/guardian; add tiers.py, HomeRule, PersonRule, PresenceRule; requester on Proposal
modules.responsibility: Sole approver of every effect; posture; charter; the human gate reserved for where it is cheap and matters.
key_algorithms_or_methods: Week-one closure (embodied, verified gap): HomeRule imports contracts/home/policy.classify_call and recomputes reversibility from the proposal's args for home_call, cam_*, ring_*, media/cast and any tool tagged physical, never trusting proposal.reversibility; applies CLIMATE_HARD_LIMITS, ALWAYS_HUMAN_SERVICES, per-entity rate limits; a separate [guardian.physical] posture with auto_approve=false and irreversible_requires_human=true, independent of the code axis that sim.sh's SIMORGH_GUARDIAN_AUTO_APPROVE covers; a kernel self-check drill proposes lock.unlock labelled 'reversible' and asserts escalation.

Requester on every Proposal: requester{person_id, role, channel, verified} defaulting to 'unknown'; PersonRule reads the People permission matrix (role x {read_only, media, reversible_home, human_home, code, memory_forget} -> allow | ask(owner) | deny); PresenceRule: a human-class approval by voice requires the approving person present (belief > 0.8) and speaker-verified (score >= 0.70, margin >= 0.10), else the phone path.

Safety tiers 0-3 (systems, the general frame): tier = f(reversibility, scope, origin, blast_radius) from the Tool protocol fields plus a per-tool override table; tier 0 read-only allow and log; tier 1 reversible in scope allow in guarded, deny in locked; tier 2 irreversible but local and bounded (commit/land, sandboxed shell, package install, device actions with undo) allow if the tool declares an undo or posture is trusted, else escalate, rate-limited; tier 3 external, physical or financial (notify a third party, run_remote, sirens, mail send, purchases, publishing, unlock/disarm) human in every posture. Tier and rule recorded on every decision.
Rules read typed args validated against the tool's input_schema instead of guessing 'subject'/'path' (_SUBJECT_ARG_KEYS); ProtectedRule and ScopeRule get exact paths, DenylistRule exact code fields.

Protected subjects extended: agents/ definitions, the hooks list, the rules/ and skills roots the growth loop writes to, evals gate config, [guardian.physical]; tightening automatic on failure streaks and denial rates; loosening only by human config change.
modules.interfaces: Unchanged topics; action.proposed gains requester and physical{service, entity_id, area}; action.approved/denied gain tier and rule; ui.prompt only for tier 3 and PersonRule 'ask'. Handle: approvals/denials per tier per day; tier-3 effects that reached Execution without a human (must be 0, drilled at boot).

modules.name: execution
modules.from: keep simorgh/execution; narrow later (vision.py and the cam/ring watchers move to a perception module in the final stage)
modules.responsibility: The hands: tools, sandboxes, worktrees, MCP, domains; structured results.
key_algorithms_or_methods: tool.registered carries the full ToolSpec{name, description, input_schema (the Tool's args_schema, today never serialised), reversibility, read_only, network, cost_class, source: builtin|mcp:<server>|skill, tags}; replayed at boot; World Model finally writes capabilities['tools'] from it.

MCP proxies pass input_schema through unflattened so multi-property tools are callable (mcp_single_arg_key retired with the marker path); MCP is the integration standard for new external capability, human-configured servers, every call still Guardian-gated.

ToolResult carries a structured payload + blob ref + a short model-facing summary (progressive disclosure via recall_result) replacing the 8,000-char class-constant cut; every tool call a span with success and latency; per-tool deadline from the envelope.

home_call unchanged in shape (ambiguity refused, before/after snapshot, undo table); add home_automation_create/enable/disable and home_scene_apply as tier-3 tools when HA is configured; registry seeded from HA's area/device registry; workspace retention bounded by age and size.

browse_page grows into a snapshot-act loop (accessibility-tree snapshot, act by element id, bounded steps) used by a browser agent definition; sandbox/test runs as subprocesses with kill-on-deadline; engines out of process only when spans show a stall on the critical path (deferred, per judges).
modules.interfaces: Unchanged action.approved -> action.result (gaining span_id, summary, result_ref); tool.registered richer. Handle: per-tool success rate and p95 latency from spans; MCP tools callable percentage.

modules.name: verification
modules.from: keep simorgh/verification
modules.responsibility: Independent critic: mechanical checks cheapest-first, checklist, trajectory; checkpoint critic; the scorer inside evals.
key_algorithms_or_methods: Stop hook of verify:true agents with a bounded revise loop (max_revisions); also runnable as a fresh-context verify sub-agent for high-rigor tasks.

Trajectory check over the session stream: every claimed effect in the final text has a matching successful ToolResult from a mutating tool; replaces claimed_to_commit / claimed_tv_act / promised_behaviour on native paths.

Checkpoint critic (cognitive): at every progress note, score the trajectory against the node's acceptance criteria returning {on_track|drifting|blocked, unmet[], next}; two consecutive drifting verdicts trigger re-planning; insufficient_evidence preserved.
Critic loop only where an oracle exists (tests, schema, diff applies); the LLM reviewer stays off for research (measured not a net gain); pure score(trajectory, oracle) exported to evals.
modules.interfaces: Unchanged verify.requested/result; add verify.checkpoint.request/reply and verify.eval.request/reply. Handle: false-completion rate on the trial suite; critic precision (drifting verdicts followed by failure if ignored).

modules.name: planning
modules.from: keep simorgh/planning; model.py, decomposer.py, reground.py, service.py extended
modules.responsibility: Goals -> projects -> typed task DAG with acceptance criteria; waiting states; re-planning; rollups; leases.
key_algorithms_or_methods: Decomposition by a planner agent definition returning a typed Plan artifact (JSON: nodes {kind: patch|research|action|question|wait, subject, acceptance[], depends_on, agent}) validated by schema, replacing the numbered-list regex; kind 'action' scoped to tool families so a household goal decomposes without a repo path; DEFAULT_SOURCE_ROOTS no longer points at src/.

WAITING status with wake condition (until: ts | event: topic+filter | human: question_id); the Kernel scheduler publishes task.wake; a human answer arrives as task.answer; project sessions wait on children by subscribing to task.completed/failed, never through the work queue.

Re-grounding as re-planning: a structured subtree revision on the cheap tier replacing STILL_VALID yes/no; verdict voting for what remains; risk from the Self Model: a node whose posterior mean is below threshold or sample count low runs in plan mode with a human gate.
Rollup stays a pure function of children.
modules.interfaces: Keep plan.proposed/approved/revised, task.*; add task.waiting, task.wake, task.answer, plan.node.verified and the Plan artifact schema. Handle: projects that produce and complete children (today zero); wall time to completion for a scripted multi-day goal.

modules.name: worldmodel (Self Model, world:home, People store)
modules.from: keep simorgh/worldmodel; selfmodel.py becomes a fold of a durable self:model stream; new facets home.py and presence.py; absorbs persona/user_model.py and voice/session.py's _room deque; hosts the People store defined in contracts/people.py
modules.responsibility: Three durable projections: a Self Model of estimated quantities; an environment state of the household; the People model.
key_algorithms_or_methods: Self Model = fold of tool.registered (capabilities.tools written, week one), skills catalog, learn.competence.updated, benchmark/eval history, learn.self_patch.*, system.started; Beta(alpha, beta) per task_type and (task_type, strategy) with exponential forgetting (weight 0.5^(age/half_life)); calibration as expected calibration error; per-tool p(ok) and latency quantiles from action.result; per-provider quality per purpose from verify.result; compute_gaps returns areas ranked by posterior mean minus a confidence term with sample counts (week one, replacing []); summary rendered from posteriors with sample counts ('patch:memory 62% over 13, overconfident'); snapshots every N events, rebuilt on boot in milliseconds.

world:home: entity state table as a projection of events already on the bus (camera.event, tv.state, voice speaker identification, calendar reads, action.result of home/media/pim tools) and of percept.home.state_changed when HA is bridged; per-(person, area) presence belief updated by evidence likelihoods with exponential decay, reported as a distribution with 'unknown', never a bare name; situation facts as pure rules (quiet_hours, someone_asleep, nobody_home, tv_playing, child_alone); staleness = age / learned typical change rate; the 'world now' block (~200 tokens) renders only fresh entities and names stale ones unknown; room transcript ring per area (3-minute horizon) plus the 48-hour overheard store.

People: Person{person_id, linked identities (voice embedding set, Telegram id, WhatsApp number, HA person, CLI=owner), role tier owner|adult|child|guest|unknown, permission matrix, memory namespace, preferences}; identity resolution at every channel edge before a percept is published; 'unknown' default; every link an owner action through Guardian via people_* tools.
modules.interfaces: Keep self.summary/self.gaps/world.env.query; add self.estimate.request/reply, world.entity.observed, world.home.situation_changed, people.resolve; SelfModelReader in-process. Handle: 'what can you do' answered from data; staleness per facet; presence accuracy against a family-corrected diary; false-fresh rate.

modules.name: initiative (unprompted behaviour)
modules.from: new small module (simorgh/initiative/ or a sub-package of persona) merging curiosity/sharing.py + persona/sharing.py + execution/vision.py's announce step + delivery of kernel/scheduler.py reminders + voice backchannel greetings
modules.responsibility: The only path by which Sim speaks or messages without being asked; every delivery is a guarded action.
key_algorithms_or_methods: Utility = urgency(class) x relevance(person) - interruption_cost(activity, time, channel) from world:home; classes: safety_alert (always, all channels), event_fyi (only when someone is present and awake, else the owner's phone), reminder (to its person wherever they are), growth/news (digest or idle with an adult present).

Presence-aware routing: voice in the area where the person is (belief > 0.6), else phone, else queue for the next time they address Sim; per-person do-not-disturb windows, per-class cooldowns, daily cap.

Every delivery is action.proposed{tool: speak|notify, reversibility: 'attention'} so 'Sim talks too much' is a Guardian posture; a HOLD state in the turn manager so a proactive utterance waits for the floor and yields to any person speaking; initiative.suppressed{why} recorded for measurement.
modules.interfaces: Consumes world.home.situation_changed, percept.home.detection, schedule.fired, curiosity.share.proposed, persona.share.proposed; produces action.proposed and initiative.suppressed. Handle: unprompted utterances per day per person and the fraction the family marks unwanted from the phone.

modules.name: growth (the improvement loop)
modules.from: merge of simorgh/learning + reflection + curiosity into simorgh/growth/ (estimate.py, diagnose.py, policies.py, explore.py, monitors.py; published topics learn.*, reflect.*, curiosity.* preserved so no consumer changes). Harness named it improve/; the name is cosmetic, the shape is cognitive's store with systems' promotion signal and harness's output rule.
modules.responsibility: Turn evidence (traces, verified outcomes, eval and benchmark runs, denials, drift, failure clusters) into proposals through the harness; adopt only what a held-out eval shows helps; maintain competence; schedule idle-time exploration.
key_algorithms_or_methods: Policy artifact store growth:policies: {id, kind: rule|skill|routing|patch, task_type|purpose, body, evidence_refs, evaluated_on, baseline, result, adopted_at, ttl, status}. Adoption lands as a committed file under a Guardian-protected root (rules/<task_type>.md rendered into the agent body; skills as SKILL.md in simorgh_skills; routing as a config PR; patches through worktree landing) via action.proposed(policy_adopt), never as a live-mutable prompt store. This resolves judge 1's objection (prompt self-modification whose 'only adds restrictions' promise cannot be checked) with judge 2/3's preference for rules first: both rules and skills are files, diffable, A/B'd on the trial suite for their task_type before active, and loosening a protected file is human-only.

Promotion signal: held-out case set for that task_type (trial suite and benchmark cases tagged by type) run in a worktree, >=3 repeats, adopt only on no regression plus at least one motivating case fixed; competence posteriors fed from verify-backed outcomes and eval pass rates as separate weighted sources, never chat self-reports (systems' correction of 07 review item 11).

Diagnose: deterministic clustering of terminal failures by (task_type, failed verify check, denied tool, critic unmet-item hash); a cluster with >= 3 members above the type's baseline becomes a lesson candidate; the model is asked only to phrase it. Reflection's pattern/denial miners and distillation.py kept.

Explore: Thompson sampling over Beta posteriors and world-model unknowns (draw per area, pick the lowest draw), keeping the sampler's diversity-by-construction and its regression test; target space extended beyond repo areas to unanswered recurring questions, stale high-query facts, devices never probed, skills never exercised; boredom still flattens by temperature.

Nightly loop on system.tick.sleep, budget-capped on the cheap tier: run evals and benchmarks, mine failed traces, draft skills with a skill-writer agent definition, extract facts, propose routing/prompt/config changes as PRs; retire on TTL or posterior drop with bounded rollback (simloader's shape); routine mining from HA history (histograms, windowed episode mining, person-conditioned preferences) with a proposed -> shown -> accepted|declined lifecycle installed as HA automations through tier-3 tools, only once HA history exists.

Delete learning/pipeline.py PatchPipeline, learn.pipeline.run and the draft_candidate/self_patch.draft references (verified unreachable); the loop can never touch guardian/, contracts/, kernel/, agents/, hooks, its own protected roots or the evals gate (Guardian-protected subjects, not a convention).

capability_programs.current_state: One think per step at reasoning_effort 'low' on the cheapest Together model for every purpose; tool calls parsed from prose (a parse tax and a correction turn on every police trigger); no planner/actor/critic separation inside a task; tier escalation exists (session.py::_tier, routes map) but is unset; Verification only at task end; the LLM answer reviewer measured as not a net gain; BFCL/GAIA/SWE-bench scored but gating nothing; leading benchmark failure is 'step budget exhausted', not wrong reasoning.
capability_programs.method: (1) Route by purpose and tier first because it is config today: strong tier for plan/decompose/critique/verify-on-failure, cheap for reground/consolidate/classify/ack, escalate_from_attempt=1 and on a drifting critic verdict; per-purpose reasoning_effort as a routed parameter. (2) Native structured tool use removes the parse tax and most correction turns; N tool_use blocks per turn so independent lookups cost one turn. (3) Plan-then-act for tasks whose budget exceeds a threshold: a planner agent definition writes a typed Plan with acceptance criteria; the executing agent keeps a plan block in the protected prefix updated through the plan built-in. (4) Critic where an oracle exists: Verification as the Stop hook with bounded revise; the checkpoint critic against acceptance criteria at every progress note; a fresh-context verify sub-agent for high-rigor tasks; no free-form LLM reviewer on research. (5) Majority vote of 3 cheap samples only for yes/no verdicts, never for drafts. (6) Situated context as data: self summary from posteriors, world-now and dialogue blocks, per-person digest, so the frontier model reasons over grounded state rather than prose. Disagreement resolved: the judges note three of four proposals understated that much of this program is choosing a stronger tier per purpose, which is config; it is the first increment.

capability_programs.method: Session transcript as a ledger stream (checkpoint = every turn, resume = fold, plus an explicit checkpoint event after every irreversible action); budgets in tokens + USD + wall-clock with the step cap as a sanity bound; compaction by measured token pressure (age tool results into re-fetchable stubs at 70% of the window, ProgressNote at 85%, protected prefix untouched) applied to every session kind; the model's ProgressNote as the carried note across attempts; projects as parent sessions that spawn in-process child sub-agents per plan step (fresh context, own budget) and await them by event with Planning's DAG order; WAITING(until|event|human) with scheduler wake-ups so a task can pause for a calendar event or an answer without holding a worker; the checkpoint critic at every note against acceptance criteria with re-planning after two drifting verdicts; heavy steps (test suite, container) as subprocesses with kill-on-deadline; standing intents evaluated by a small event-driven engine, never by a model polling, once world:home exists. result.agi_honesty: All four proposals and all three judges say the same thing and the code agrees: Simorgh is a harness around a frontier model, and its general intelligence is the model's. Nothing here learns at the weight level; no loop design gives Sim competence the model it calls does not have; a stronger foundation model behind this harness will look far more capable than a weaker one, and that gap is the model's, not Sim's. The harness decides how much of the model's intelligence reaches the world, how reliably, for how long, for whom, and how safely. What this architecture can deliver, and what 'more general' concretely means for a household agent, is five measured numbers in the ledger: (1) coverage: a rising fraction of the family's real goals completed end to end (files, web, calendar, mail, home devices, TV, cameras, code) without the creator stepping in, from a scripted household suite; (2) horizon: tasks that span hours, restarts and human interruptions with the same safety profile, from the resume and long-task suites; (3) continuity: knowing several people across months with corrections that stick and privacy that holds, from the recall scenario; (4) transfer: a skill, rule or fact learned in one task helping on a held-out one, from A/B on the trial suite; (5) breadth: new capability arriving as MCP servers, skills and HA automations rather than subsystems, with a person asked only at tier 3. That is the blueprint's own stance (01 section 2.1: generality as a queryable number the Self Model reports, including what Sim still cannot do) and it should stay the only use of the word. What compounds: the eval suite, the ledger of transcripts (every future eval and distillation reads it), the fact store, the world state, the skills and rules library, the tool schemas, the safety tiers, and the model upgrades a clean native-tool gateway makes free. What does not compound: regex police, dated incident comments, per-tool argument hacks, bespoke command dispatch, more subsystems, and any growth mechanism not scored by an eval. Two limits stated plainly: the loop cannot verify its own honesty without external checks (Verification, evals, the family's corrections), and corrigibility must stay outside anything the growth loop can touch, which this plan keeps by Guardian-protecting agent definitions, hooks, the policy roots and the eval gate. The honest target is the one the embodied lens named: the most trustworthy, most capable, continuously improving personal agent in this house, with zero unapproved physical effects, sub-second first audio, presence and addressee accuracy the family stops noticing, and routines it learnt that still run when it is switched off. If the models keep improving, this is the harness that lets Sim absorb that improvement without another rewrite; it will not be AGI under any definition that requires learning beyond its model, and saying otherwise would contradict SOUL.md's transparency directive.
result.biggest_risk_of_this_proposal: Half-migration by one developer working through coding agents: the project's own dominant bug shape is the unconnected wire, and this plan is the largest producer of them there is (two tool protocols, two trace formats, two memory indexes, two budgets, two session models, each half-read by something) on a live checkout that boots the family's assistant under a unit suite that asserts shape and missed every real blocker. The ordering is the mitigation and it is non-negotiable: safety closure and the gate before any behaviour change; one stage in flight at a time; every stage landed through the worktree path with trial-suite and benchmark deltas at >=3 repeats recorded in docs/findings/; each stage's old path deleted before the next begins; file moves separated from behaviour changes and pushed to the end; native tool use flipped per model only after it beats markers on BFCL for the model actually in use, with the marker dialect and its police kept on every text-only provider path (the Claude Code CLI wrapper is the live day-cap failover); and the growth loop adopting nothing until its task_type has a held-out set with a stored baseline. Three specific hazards inside that: the cheap Together model's native tool-calling quality is unmeasured and may be worse than markers (configure the second native-tool provider before judging); the session stream and the People model change what the TUI, voice privacy filter and memory namespace assume (the recall scenario's cross-person case is the gate); and everything embodied past the safety closure depends on Home Assistant being installed, a hardware decision the creator has not made in nine days, so nothing in stages 0-8 may be allowed to wait on it. The Guardian invariant and corrigibility are untouched by every stage, which is what makes doing this live defensible at all.
